messages:
liam: Heads-up: next week were retiring the last Jenkins controller and moving workloads to Buildkite + self-hosted agents. Cutover window: 2026-04-02 01:00-02:00 UTC.

liam: Why: Jenkins plugins and maintenance overhead are blocking parallelism and we want consistent observability with Buildkite traces. This also ties into the org-wide OIDC token enforcement for CI.

priya: ack. Any action items for teams?

liam: Short list: 1) stop new Jenkins job creation now; 2) convert top-10 busiest jobs to Buildkite by 2026-03-31; 3) remove hard-coded credentials in jobs and switch to OIDC where possible; 4) update status badges in READMEs after cutover. Full checklist on PLAT-7890.

emma: For repos using Jenkinsfile library from `infra/jenkins-shared`, whats the migration path?

liam: We published a migration library and example pipelines in `platform/buildkite-templates`. Use the adapter script `scripts/migrate/jenkins-to-buildkite.sh` to generate basic pipeline YAML. It won't cover custom groovy hooks.

priya: Any downtime for deploys?

infra-oncall: We'll do a staged drain: agents will be drained at 01:05 UTC, final controller shutdown 01:20 UTC. Builds running at time of drain will be allowed to finish if they have <30m remaining; otherwise they will be canceled and re-run in Buildkite automatically via an intent tag we add. Expected total disruption <15m for some long jobs.

security: Note on auth: as part of this we will enforce OIDC for tokens issued to builds. If your job relies on long-lived deploy keys or service-user tokens, rotate to short-lived creds or attach a service account via our KMS-proxy. We will block requests that use legacy token scopes after cutover.

liam: Commands to scan repos for Jenkins references:
```bash
# find Jenkinsfiles and references
grep -R "Jenkinsfile" --exclude-dir=node_modules || true
# find infra library imports
grep -R "infra/jenkins-shared" || true
```

liam: Quick example to generate a Buildkite pipeline from an existing Jenkinsfile (best-effort):
```bash
./scripts/migrate/jenkins-to-buildkite.sh path/to/repo > .buildkite/pipeline.yml
git add .buildkite/pipeline.yml && git commit -m "migrate: jenkins -> buildkite"
```

priya: What about status checks and branch protections that reference Jenkins status contexts?

emma: We'll publish a mapping table. Default mapping: `jenkins/ci` -> `buildkite/ci` and we'll add provisional contexts during the migration window so protected branches won't briefly fail. Still please avoid merging right around 01:00 UTC.

ops-bot: @channel Dry-run scheduled in the staging org on 2026-04-01 23:00 UTC. Live cutover 2026-04-02 01:00 UTC. Will post live events.

liam: Rollback plan: we keep the Jenkins controller snapshot and can re-enable it and flip DNS back within 20m. We will only rollback if >10% job failures across the top-20 pipelines or if OIDC mis-issuance prevents deploys.

security: We'll be watching token issuance and rotate the OIDC provider certs 30m before cutover. If you see 401s, gather build URL + pipeline id and post here.

priya: Any manual tasks for infra owners?

emma: Owners: please whitelist agent images in the new Buildkite fleet, and ensure any secrets referenced by agents are mounted via Vault-agent sidecar. See `platform/docs/buildkite-agent-setup.md`.

liam: Small ask: label any migrated pipeline with `migrated-by:<your-name>` so we can validate success metrics.

infra-oncall: Live dry-run completed in staging at 23:05 UTC; no auth regressions observed.

ops-bot: Live cutover started at 01:00:12 UTC. Draining Jenkins agents.

ops-bot: Buildkite pipelines queued and agents registered at 01:07:54 UTC. First cohort of builds re-run automatically.

infra-oncall: Observed 3 canceled Jenkins jobs that exceeded the 30m threshold; all re-ran successfully in Buildkite. No increase in 5xx API errors.

security: OIDC token issuance verified for sample pipelines. No legacy tokens detected post-cutover.

liam: Excellent. Thanks for the fast turnaround. Please post any post-cutover regressions here with links. We'll keep the Jenkins controller in read-only for 48h before decommission.

priya: Merged migration PRs for 4 repos. Marking them with migrated-by:priya.

emma: I updated the README badges.

infra-oncall: Final check: all top-20 pipelines green. Marking PLAT-7890 as resolved.

liam: Closing thread. :tada:
